root_cause_criterion.obligation: After shifting unread pkt-line bytes, gitno_consume must leave buf->data[buf->offset] as a NUL terminator before later code treats the remaining bytes as a C string.
root_cause_criterion.fix_mechanism: The fixed transport path consumes pkt-line bytes with git_staticstr_consume(), which restores data[len] = "\0" before set_data performs capability-string searches.

nodes.description: The object-format strstr in set_data executes on the shifted pkt-line buffer that was just consumed, so an unterminated logical end at that buffer carries directly into the unbounded capability scan.

edges.description: The shifted buffer base after gitno_consume is the same pkt-line buffer base that set_data later searches for the object-format capability.
